rubric.hypertrophy: On target means most muscles you programmed hit 8–20 sets and 2–3 days this week.
rubric.strength: On target means 20–40% of your sets are 6 reps or fewer, with rest of 150 seconds or more.
rubric.endurance: On target means one Circuit, or enough short-rest high-rep sets.
rubric.balance: A number from how evenly this week hits the muscle list. Not last month’s sessions.

empty.scores: Add a day to see what this program is for.

offline: Scores will show when this week is already on the phone.
